summary: This standards-track document defines DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 options that give a client its coordinate-based location: latitude, longitude, and altitude, with resolution indicators and the reference datum. A network can tell a device where it is as part of normal address setup.

eli5.summary: When your device joins a network, the network can also tell it where on the map it is, using the same message that gives it an address.
